fofcSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Two-Stage FO-FC Hybrid Concentration Skid (Hollow-Fiber FO + Tubular PFC Crystallizer)
fofcSystems.classification: Sanitary Food & Bioactive Hybrid Concentrator (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / 3-A Sanitary Standards / EHEDG Doc 8)
fofcSystems.description: Two-stage continuous hybrid concentration train combining low-fouling aquaporin biomimetic hollow-fiber forward osmosis membranes for stage-1 dewatering (10° to 32° Brix) with continuous tubular progressive freeze crystallizers for stage-2 ice crystallization up to 62° Brix without heat.

fofcSystems.name: Pilot Multi-Pass Rotary Drum FO-FC Skid (Plate-and-Frame FO + Rotary Scraped Freeze Concentrator)
fofcSystems.classification: Pilot Plant Food Technology System (CE Machinery / USDA Dairy Approved)
fofcSystems.description: Flexible pilot skid utilizing flat-sheet thin-film composite (TFC) forward osmosis cassettes coupled with a continuous internal-refrigerant rotary drum freeze concentrator for high-viscosity juices and dairy extracts.

fofcSystems.name: Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Ultra-High Rejection FO-FC Skid (Biomimetic FO + Multi-Tube Cryo-PFC)
fofcSystems.classification: Aseptic Bioprocess Concentrator (ASME BPE-2024 / FDA cGMP / ISO Class 7 Cleanroom)
fofcSystems.description: Sanitary 316L stainless steel automated skid for high-purity immunoglobulins, bioactive peptides, and thermolabile enzymes. Employs food-grade organic osmolyte draw solution and multi-tube aseptic freeze crystallizers with automated ice harvesting.

fofcSystems.name: Modular Containerized Farm-Gate FO-FC Concentration Unit (Energy-Optimized Mobile Skid)
fofcSystems.classification: Agricultural Field Processing Skid (NEMA 4X / IP66 / USDA APHIS)
fofcSystems.description: Field-deployable skid for on-site concentration of cold-pressed craft berries, maple sap, and botanical infusions directly at harvest to eliminate raw water transport costs.

thermolabileFeeds.name: Cold-Pressed Wild Blackcurrant Juice (Delphinidin Anthocyanins & Vitamin C)
thermolabileFeeds.description: Delicate dark berry juice rich in anthocyanins and volatile ethyl butyrate aroma esters that are completely destroyed or boiled off in thermal vacuum pans.

thermolabileFeeds.name: Bovine Colostrum Whey Fraction (Native Immunoglobulins IgG & Lactoferrin)
thermolabileFeeds.description: High-value immunoglobulin fraction from early-lactation dairy cows. Extremely heat-sensitive; proteins irreversibly precipitate and denature at temperatures above 50°C.

thermolabileFeeds.name: Single-Strength Valencia Orange Juice (Terpenes, Aldehydes & Valence Esters)
thermolabileFeeds.description: Citrus juice with delicate floral and fruity volatiles. Standard TASTE thermal evaporators evaporate over 70% of fresh volatiles, forcing synthetic aroma pack restitution.

thermolabileFeeds.name: Fresh Honeybee Royal Jelly Solution (10-HDA & Royalactin Peptides)
thermolabileFeeds.description: Viscous nutritional colloidal suspension with heat-labile fatty acids and proteins. FO-FC produces a stable thick syrup at 4°C with zero thermal degradation.

drawSolutions.name: Food-Grade Magnesium Chloride (MgCl2, 28 wt%, Osmotic Pressure 115 bar)
drawSolutions.reverseSoluteFluxRisk: Extremely Low (< 0.03 g/m²·h, complies with FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 184.1426)
drawSolutions.description: High osmotic pressure divalent electrolyte draw solution providing strong driving force for dense juices up to 35° Brix with minimal reverse salt migration.

drawSolutions.name: Potassium Lactate Organic Osmolyte (50 wt%, Osmotic Pressure 92 bar)
drawSolutions.reverseSoluteFluxRisk: Zero toxicity (Natural food acidulant salt, FDA GRAS)
drawSolutions.description: Organic draw solution with neutral taste profile and biocompatible ions, ideal for clean-label organic fruit concentrates and dairy bio-fractions.

drawSolutions.name: Refined Invert Liquid Sucrose Draw (68° Brix, Osmotic Pressure 75 bar)
drawSolutions.reverseSoluteFluxRisk: Zero chemical contamination (Edible food matrix component)
drawSolutions.regenerationMethod: Thermal falling film re-concentration or solar evaporation
drawSolutions.description: Nutritional draw solution where any minor reverse flux simply adds natural sugar to the fruit juice without introducing foreign electrolytes.

crystallizationModes.name: Progressive Freeze Concentration Tubular Crystallizer (PFC, Cooling rate 0.5°C/min)
crystallizationModes.crystalMorphology: Planar Ice Front (Single Solid Annular Layer on Tube ID)
crystallizationModes.description: Liquid circulates turbulently (Re > 4,000) inside cooled tubes; a crystal-clear layer of pure ice builds smoothly on the tube wall, excluding all solute molecules.

crystallizationModes.name: Suspension Freeze Concentration (SFC, Nucleator + Ripening Tank + Wash Column)
crystallizationModes.crystalMorphology: Spherical Ripened Ice Crystals (0.5 to 1.2 mm diameter)
crystallizationModes.description: Produces spherical slurry crystals in a growth ripening vessel; separated continuously via hydraulic wash column for high-throughput operations.

crystallizationModes.name: Rotary Drum Contact Freeze Concentrator (Thin Film Ice Freezing & Doctor Blade)
crystallizationModes.crystalMorphology: Thin Ice Flakes Scraped from Submerged Drum Surface
crystallizationModes.description: Rotary drum dipping into cold juice tray freezes thin ice film, continuously scraped off by sanitary UHMW doctor blade for viscous purees.
